NameError when using response_type=none in OAuth2 authorization flow

#### Description

When making an OAuth2 authorization request with `response_type=none`, a `NameError` occurs because the `state` variable is referenced but not defined in the scope.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from oauthlib.oauth2 import WebApplicationServer

# Create a simple OAuth2 server
server = WebApplicationServer(None)

# Make an authorization request with response_type=none and state parameter
uri = 'http://example.com/auth?response_type=none&client_id=test&state=xyz&redirect_uri=http://back.to/me'

# This will raise a NameError
headers, body, status_code = server.create_authorization_response(uri, scopes=['read'])
```

The error occurs when the authorization flow tries to handle the `response_type=none` case but references an undefined `state` variable.
</issue>
